paper_metadata.title: Evolution of Intermetallics, Dispersoids, and Elevated Temperature Properties at Various Fe Contents in Al-Mn-Mg 3004 Alloys

evidence.quote: Al-Mn-Mg 3004 alloys have been found to possess considerably high mechanical properties and creep resistance at elevated temperature
the inﬂuence of Fe contents on the evolution of microstructure and properties in Al-Mn-Mg 3004 alloys have been investigated
the dominant intermetallics change from a-Al(MnFe)Si at 0.1 pct Fe to Al6(MnFe) at both 0.3 and 0.6 wt pct Fe

parameters.cooling_method: poured into permanent mold preheated at 523 K (250 C)

evidence.quote: The temperature of the melt was maintained at ~1023 K (~750 C) for 30 minutes. The melt was degassed for 15 minutes and then poured into the permanent mold preheated at 523 K (250 C).

Hence, a precipitation treatment at 648 K (375 C) up to 72 hours was selected to study the evolution of dispersoids with various Fe contents. A programmable electric furnace with the temperature controller (±2K) and circulating air was used for the heat treatment. The heating rate was set as 5 K/min. After the precipitation treatment, the ingots were directly quenched into water at RT.
Figure 5 shows the intermetallic microstructure after the precipitation treatment [648 K (375 C)/48 hours].
